The '''Badlands''' were a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] and rocky area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], between [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] and [[New Meen]]. An [[old lylek den]] could be found there.<ref name="LongArm" />
